summary: Part 1d Position Sizer verified frontend-only, no backend changes retested per handoff. Fresh POST /api/analyze for NVDA returned decision=SELL, price=218.29, stop=225, target=210, grounding=grounded — a clean active-sizing case. On https://trade-agent-app.preview.emergentagent.com/analysis/1879ebad-85b7-436d-83a2-c0dc5000582b the VERDICT tab shows the testID='position-sizer' card directly under GroundingBadge with header 'POSITION SIZER' / 'RISK DISPOSES · NOT ADVICE'. Deterministic math matches spec: perShareRisk=6.71, byRisk=floor(1000/6.71)=149, byCap=floor(100000*0.20/218.29)=91 → qty=91 shares (position-cap-limited); NOTIONAL $19,864, AT RISK 611 (0.61%), TO TARGET 754, R:R 1:1.24, note reads 'Capped by max position % (risk budget alone allowed more). Per-share risk 6.71.' LIVE EDIT: capital 100000→200000 recomputed to 183 shares, 100000→250000 to 229 shares (both = floor(capital*0.2/218.29), confirming byCap scales linearly until risk budget would bite). PERSISTENCE: after setting CAPITAL=250000, page.reload() and a fresh page.goto() to the same URL both restored CAPITAL=250000 (RISK=1, MAX=20 unchanged). DISABLED: HOLD analysis 6dbf6223-256e-486f-a23e-855d4c3e1930 renders position-sizer with the exact blocker text 'HOLD verdict — no position to size.' and no share count / stats. NON-REGRESSION on both analyses: GroundingBadge (LEVELS VERIFIED / LEVELS · CHECK), TradingView chart + range bar, VerdictLevels TARGET/STOP-LOSS, FEAR & GREED gauge, LATEST HEADLINES and ROUND TABLE DEBATE all render, no red screen, no console errors (only benign warnings: pointerEvents deprecation, sandbox iframe warning — unrelated to this change).
critical_code_review_comments: PositionSizer.tsx AT RISK % divides by Number(capital)||1 while sizePosition() uses the same capital as its riskBudget input — consistent, but if capital is left empty the '%' would silently show 0 with divide-by-1; minor edge case, not user-reachable through the numeric keypad.

sizer:capital / sizer:risk_pct / sizer:max_pos_pct are persisted on every keystroke (useEffect dep on the three strings). Fine for AsyncStorage but a small debounce would avoid ~5 writes per typed digit.
seed_data_creation: Triggered one fresh analysis via POST /api/analyze {symbol:'NVDA'} → id 1879ebad-85b7-436d-83a2-c0dc5000582b (SELL, grounded). Reused pre-existing HOLD id 6dbf6223-256e-486f-a23e-855d4c3e1930.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Position Sizer is wired correctly and deterministic. Card sits between GroundingBadge and FearGreedGauge in VerdictView (analysis/[id].tsx:359). sizePosition() is exported for unit re-use. Persistence is via storage util keys sizer:capital / sizer:risk_pct / sizer:max_pos_pct through AsyncStorage's IndexedDB shim on web — note that a NEW Playwright browser context starts with a clean IndexedDB, so persistence must be tested via page.reload()/page.goto() within the same run, not across separate script invocations. Blocker texts are: 'HOLD verdict — no position to size.', 'Levels were rejected by the grounding check — sizing disabled.', 'No live price available.', 'No stop loss in the verdict — cannot size risk.' Only the HOLD one was reachable without controlling the LLM.
